recruit_bard.label: Recruit the Bad Bard
recruit_bard.description: Add the Bad Bard as a fourth recruit choice for your three-person company. He brings both songs and their standing orders.

teach_healer_blast.label: Teach the Healer: Blast nearest
teach_healer_blast.description: Let the Healer equip Blast in place of Bonk. It hits the nearest damageable target, including a friend or obstacle. The Caster keeps his own Blast.

song_weaving.label: Song Weaving
song_weaving.description: A future Bard technique. Not available in this guild yet.
